profile.name: Tang Keng Hin
profile.intro: Building secure systems and intelligent solutions at the intersection of cybersecurity, backend development, cloud computing, and IT infrastructure.
profile.availabilityDetail: Actively seeking a 16+ week internship where I can contribute, learn, and grow with a dynamic technical team.

about.heading: Curious. Disciplined. Security-Minded.
paragraphs: A highly motivated Year 3 Computer Science student specializing in Cybersecurity, with a strong technical foundation in backend development, cloud computing, and IT infrastructure.
I possess a solid grasp of Data Structures and Algorithms and hands-on experience building practical solutions, including Java-based applications and a Python chatbot.
I am passionate about applying security-first concepts to develop robust, efficient, and user-centric software, and I am currently seeking an internship placement of 16+ weeks.

projects.title: innoLink Chatbot
projects.shortDescription: A PySide6 investor-messaging prototype with animated chat, multimedia feedback, and in-app video calling.
projects.description: A high-fidelity desktop messaging prototype for InnoLink, a platform that connects Southeast Asian startup founders with angel investors. Built with Python and PySide6, it recreates a one-to-one investor chat with animated message bubbles, typing and online indicators, automatic replies, an intro video, a looping video-call screen, and low-latency sound feedback for sending, receiving, typing, and ringing.

projects.title: MySafety
projects.shortDescription: A Java Swing public-safety system combining alerts, disaster guidance, air-quality monitoring, and community discussion.
projects.description: MySafety is a role-based Java Swing desktop application for public-safety awareness and community communication. Users can register and sign in, browse searchable announcements, monitor Kuala Lumpur Air Pollutant Index updates, follow earthquake, flood, and tsunami guidance, read environmental-awareness content, and participate in a forum with image uploads. Admin tools manage announcements and educational content, while application data is stored locally in text files.

projects.title: Fitness Application
projects.shortDescription: A JavaFX fitness and nutrition tracker with secure accounts, goals, charts, BMI, and achievement tracking.
projects.description: A JavaFX and FXML desktop health tracker that gives each user a private fitness workspace. It supports registration and PBKDF2-secured login, profile and BMI management, dated nutrition and workout records, automatic calorie and distance calculations, personal goals, progress bars, charts, and achievement unlocking. Data is isolated per user in local files, and automated tests cover authentication, calculations, interface loading, persistence, and malformed-record recovery.

projects.title: tang-portfolio
projects.shortDescription: A responsive React portfolio with a Supabase-powered Admin CMS for managing content, projects, and credentials.
projects.description: A responsive multi-page portfolio built with React 19 and Vite to present academic progress, skills, experience, projects, awards, and certificates. Its authenticated Admin workspace stores editable content in Supabase PostgreSQL, uploads portraits, project logos, and documents to Supabase Storage, and protects write access with Supabase Auth and Row Level Security. React Router, Motion animations, responsive CSS, GitHub, and automatic Vercel deployments complete the production workflow.

projects.title: Enhance E-Hailing App - Software Security System
projects.shortDescription: A security-first e-hailing prototype covering KYC, passkeys, face recognition, and protected ride booking.
projects.description: A Figma Make mobile prototype that redesigns an e-hailing journey around identity verification and account security. The flow moves from Gmail sign-in through KYC data and document collection, mandatory biometric and passkey setup with fingerprint and PIN confirmation, vehicle and destination selection, face recognition, and final booking. Interactive validation, animated verification feedback, route previews, estimated travel times, and end-to-end data flow keep the dark lime-accented experience clear and consistent.

projects.title: Enhance MySejahtera App UI - Software Security System
projects.shortDescription: A secure MySejahtera UI prototype with timed OTP login, mandatory biometrics, and protected account settings.
projects.description: A Figma Make redesign of MySejahtera focused on secure authentication and clearer healthcare navigation. It introduces phone-and-password login with a six-digit OTP and two-minute expiry, mandatory fingerprint registration, single-device security notifications, health-service shortcuts, profile and QR verification, and a complete Settings area. The password-change flow adds OTP verification, field validation, password requirements, and success feedback.

projects.title: InnoLink (Mobile App UI)
projects.shortDescription: An interactive founder-and-investor networking prototype for funding, workshops, messaging, and business discovery.
projects.description: An extensive Figma Make mobile prototype for InnoLink, a startup-networking platform that connects founders and investors. The product combines onboarding and account recovery with user and business profiles, privacy controls, investor communication, funding opportunities, workshop registration, AI-assisted recommendations, and structured feedback. Interactive apply, register, and cancel states together with field-level validation make the major flows realistic and testable.

projects.title: HotelCatz
projects.shortDescription: A responsive Wix website for cat grooming, mating, hotel, spa, and online boarding reservations.
projects.description: HotelCatz is a responsive Wix website that presents a complete pet-care and cat-boarding service. Visitors can explore grooming, mating, hotel, and spa offerings; browse the gallery and blog; review contact details and opening hours; and use the booking journey to arrange a stay. The design combines service-focused content with clear calls to action for cat owners.
